exceptions.name: Start work
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 9: Start work belongs to the shell (F-05); the admin persona has no startable lines, so the shell draws none. src/shell is not touched. As F-20 (D-71).

exceptions.name: Admin · sample
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 9: the shell prints /me as name · roles ("Ada Okafor · Admin"). As F-20 (D-71).

exceptions.name: Kemi Adebayo · PMO Lead ▾
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 2: the board draws From as a static box. The page draws the shared Select (D-91), offered only because the read sends two from_options; its accessible name is its label "From" and the chosen option shows inside it (the fidelity driver chooses Kemi Adebayo · PMO Lead with the real control). The value is on the page; the tool reads the control by its label.

exceptions.name: Femi Ade · PMO Lead ▾
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 3: as From. To is the shared Select listing delegate_options for the chosen From; the driver chooses Femi Ade · PMO Lead, shown inside the control, named "To".

exceptions.name: 18 Nov – 25 Nov 2026
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 5: the library has no range picker and E-DELEGATION sends starts and ends apart, so Dates is a fieldset (legend "Dates") of two DateFields, Starts 18 Nov 2026 and Ends 25 Nov 2026 as driven. The single range text is not drawn.

exceptions.name: Reason
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 5 (the library's fields): Reason is the shared TextField, whose label is a <label> element; the tool skips label elements. The word is on the page as the field's visible label.

exceptions.name: Annual leave
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 5 (the library's fields): in the panel the board draws the reason as a static box; the page holds it as the typed value of the Reason TextField (the driver types it). The table row's "Annual leave" is matched separately.

exceptions.name: ← Setup
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 9: the phone bar link comes from useSetupPhoneBack and the frame names it "Back to Setup" (it reads "← Setup"); as F-20 (D-71).

exceptions.name: Start
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 9: the phone bar's Start belongs to the shell; the admin persona has no startable lines. As F-20 (D-71).

exceptions.name: ADD A DELEGATION
exceptions.reason: D-92b/D-93: blue is for buttons, links and agent work; Setup form panels use the standard ink Panel head and border, as F-11 Set a rule and F-20 upload (design-system-conformance/review-ui.md). The board draws an action-blue head and border; the words are matched (UI-1-1).

visual_waivers.reason: Two date fields (Conflicts 5), the shared 44px fields against the board's 48px, the ink panel head (D-92b) and the shared Setup frame (Start work, persona text, tab badges; Conflicts 8, 9). No gap is closable in this feature.
